FN-5V1WHM6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 104
Committee: Financial Services Sponsor: Representative Chris Blackshear
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 104 as introduced could increase receipts from unclaimed property to the State
General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the value of digital assets deemed
abandoned and sold by the State Treasurer. This bill could also decrease the obligations of the
State Treasurer by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in the amount spent on
advertising of the sale of abandoned property by newspaper, as provided by current law, and the
amount spent on such advertising by other means as provided by the bill.
